jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Microsoft Purview specialist with a proven track record of delivering compliance projects for clients who’s ready to own and develop our Purview capability as the agentic landscape evolves.

What you'll do

You'll work on Microsoft Purview and compliance implementations end-to-end – from architecture and deployment to use case optimisation – with a particular focus on agentic adoption.

You'll be the person who drives the Purview agenda on behalf of an ambitious team, working across industries with organisations that are serious about data security and compliance.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Design, deployment, and optimisation of Microsoft Purview solutions, including Data Classification, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Development of data protection policies, automation workflows, and compliance reporting tailored to client requirements

• 
Assessment and reporting on the maturity of client data security and compliance deployments

• 
Definition and creation of operational and executive compliance dashboards and reports

• 
Integration activities across Microsoft Purview and the broader Microsoft 365 compliance ecosystem

You'll also collaborate closely with other engineers on the team, contribute to R&D activities, and support managed service customers in maintaining and maturing their data security practices.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least three years of hands-on experience enabling security and compliance technologies in a Microsoft environment. Beyond that, you'll bring:

• 
Strong experience with Microsoft Purview across Data Classification, Information Protection, DLP, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Hands-on experience implementing sensitivity labels, retention policies, and DLP rules

• 
Knowledge of data governance principles within the Microsoft ecosystem

• 
Current Microsoft certifications in compliance and security – or a willingness to obtain them within 90 days

• 
Strong communication skills and confidence in client-facing settings

We don't expect you to know everything. Purview and the agentic space are moving fast, and that's part of what makes this role interesting. What matters most is that you want to own it.

To be a great fit for The Tech Collective, it will be a bonus if you bring:

• 
Knowledge of LLMs and agentic workflows, including cybersecurity risk considerations

• 
Understanding of Zero Trust principles as applied to data security

• 
Experience with risk assessment methodologies and compliance reporting

• 
Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator Associate, Security Administrator Associate, or equivalent

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, you'll join a tight team of experts and enthusiasts who take both craft and collaboration seriously. We invest in your development – through training, conferences, and the space to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions, contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu or +45 31717487.

Senior IT Supporter

Hinnerup IT & udvikling Ansøg løbende

Senior IT Supporter

_Are you passionate about technology, solving complex IT challenges, and delivering exceptional support to colleagues across the globe? Do you thrive in an international environment where no two days are the same, and where your expertise helps keep the business running smoothly? Then you might be our new Senior IT Supporter at PanzerGlass HQ.

_

PanzerGlass is globally recognised as one of the leading brands in screen protection. As our new Senior IT Supporter, you will play a key role in ensuring a stable, secure, and efficient IT environment across our global organisation. You will provide advanced IT support to users worldwide, contribute to infrastructure and improvement projects, and act as a trusted technical expert within the IT team.

Key responsibilities

You will be responsible for delivering high-quality IT support and helping drive continuous improvements across our global IT environment. Your responsibilities will include:

· Providing IT support to employees across multiple locations

· Handling and coordinating support tickets, escalations, and complex technical issues

· Supporting Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, endpoint management, hardware, and software platforms

· Managing onboarding, offboarding, user administration, and access rights

· Maintaining asset management processes and supporting device lifecycle management

· Supporting local offices and remote users worldwide

· Assisting with network, security, backup, and infrastructure-related tasks

· Driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and IT documentation

· Participating in IT projects, implementations, and system upgrades

· Mentoring colleagues and sharing technical knowledge across the team

· Collaborating with external vendors and service providers to ensure reliable IT services

Your profile

You have a solid technical foundation combined with a strong service mindset. You enjoy helping others, troubleshooting complex issues, and continuously improving the way things are done.

We imagine you bring:

· Relevant IT education or equivalent practical experience

· Minimum 3-5 years of experience in IT Support, IT Operations, or a similar role

· Experience supporting users within a global organisation

· Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, and endpoint management

· Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills

· A customer-focused and service-oriented approach

· Communication skills in English, both written and verbal

· A structured and detail-oriented way of working

· The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

· A proactive and collaborative mindset

· A positive attitude with a "no job too big, no job too small" approach to work

We offer

· A company with best-in-class employee survey results – we are listed among the best workplaces in Denmark and Europe

· A culture of inclusivity and global collaboration, valuing and celebrating diverse perspectives

· An opportunity to join our trial for a 4-day working week

· A unique opportunity to join a global, fast-growing organisation

· Great opportunities for professional and personal development

· Professional and highly skilled colleagues who set the bar high

· Flexible working hours

Questions and application

We screen and interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to accept applications sent by email. Please submit your application on our Careers Page.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Process Consultant – Help Shape Energinet’s Process Work

Do you want to be part of a workplace that is continuously evolving in step with the accelerating green transition?

Then join a team with the central task of developing and documenting our OT processes.

Welcome to Energinet

In our Process Team, we are seven colleagues working closely together to document and develop business processes and workflows across Energinet.

We strive for standardized processes, which help ensure transparency, alignment, and cross-organizational overview. Furthermore, we have a strategic partnership with the Process Center of Excellence – a cross-functional office responsible for raising process maturity across all of Energinet.

You Document and Develop Processes

We work in an agile setup, where the Scrum Master facilitates the team’s events. Each day begins with a short team meeting to align on tasks and priorities. We value starting the day together before diving into individual or collaborative work.

Our main task in 2025 is to ensure that our OT processes cover our new platform, enabling us to manage operations and preparedness effectively. The work is wide-ranging and involves many capabilities and tools. We are in constant dialogue with our technical teams and security department. This requires you to collaborate with stakeholders and process owners, and to document processes according to the BPMN notation.

• Your key responsibilities will include:

• Documenting as-is processes

• Designing, developing, and maturing IT and OT processes

• Conducting stakeholder interviews

• Facilitating workshops

• Performing quality assurance

• Providing ad hoc support for process documentation and development

You Have Strong Experience in Process Management

We are looking for someone with excellent communication and analytical skills, who can translate expert knowledge into clearly documented processes aligned with Energinet’s standards. You enjoy both administrative and formalization tasks and thrive in a collaborative environment where you provide service and support across teams.

• We imagine that you:

• Have solid experience with ITIL 4

• Have experience in process mapping, preferably with BPMN

• Thrive in an agile (Scrum) environment

• Preferably have experience with ServiceNow

• Have knowledge of CMMI process maturity

• Understand the connection between main and sub-process levels, and perhaps have insight into digital processes in an IT/OT organization

• Speak and write English fluently (Danish is an advantage but not a requirement)

Special Conditions

The position requires that you can obtain and maintain a security clearance.

You can read more about this process on the PET website.

In certain cases, a background check may be required before clearance is granted.

Location and Work Setup

We are based in Fredericia and offer a flexible hybrid model for on-site and remote work.

jobs.occupation: Senior Finance Business Partner with focus on Mobility
jobs.description:
Picture yourself serving as a trusted advisor to the Danish management team in a global company, where your contribution can truly make a difference. Then imagine holding this meaningful position while working on what you do best – analysis, forecasting, and numbers.

Basico is recruiting a Senior Finance Business Partner on behalf of Circle K.

Allow us to bring the vision to life! At Circle K they are looking for you, with experience from similar roles - ready to step into this position and become part of our ambitious and highly skilled team in the Performance Management Analytics (PMA) department, based out of the Danish headquarter in Copenhagen, Sydhavn, Denmark.

It’s a numbers game – and you’ve mastered it

Circle K is one of the leading companies in Denmark in the convenience, energy, and fuel delivery sector. In Denmark, Circle K operates two different brands – Circle K and INGO – spread across 436 locations, with 211 of those operated under the Circle K brand.

As a part of Circle K’s PMA team, you will have 3 skilled colleagues you can consult with on financial matters. However, as you will be working with many different stakeholders, you will quickly learn that cooperation and collaboration across the organization is key – especially for this role.

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you will be the responsible sparring partner to both their Mobility and Sales department, translating numbers into actionable insights, building business cases, and much more. This involves sparring and partnering with the organization on matters such as fuel, E-Mobility, Car wash, B2B Customers, and more.

To be specific, your main responsibilities will be to:

· Partner with the Mobility and Sales department to create transparency in financial figures and drive qualified decision-making through fact-based recommendations.

· Work closely with the business to identify challenges and optimization opportunities.

· Analyze business performance and bring financial insights and recommendations to management.

· Improve and execute budgeting and forecasting processes within your area of responsibility, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with other areas.

· Analyze and explain developments in month-end figures.

· Build and review business cases.

· Communicate and present business cases and ad hoc analysis to management and other stakeholders.

Your business acumen makes you the preferred advisor

To be successful in this role, we imagine you have at least a few years' experience from a similar role. Since you are used to managing the interests of many different stakeholders, you have already tested your ability to work in a structured and proactive manner in an ever-changing environment, where balancing tasks is key to success.

You might hold a degree in Economics and Business administration, Accounting or Finance. Most important is however your authentic curiosity to understand causal relationships, developments, trends, and the willingness to dive into an Excel sheet full of numbers to grasp what is happening.

If you are an ambitious profile with solid understanding of finance processes, has an analytical mindset, and are motivated to make a difference, you will be a great match for the PMA team.

As sparring partner to the business, it is also important that you are able to simplify complex issues and present them with confidence to all levels in the organization in an inspiring way that makes people listen.

As you become part of an international organization where you advise colleagues from different countries, it is necessary that you are fluent in both English and Danish.

On the right path – Come join Circle K!

You will become part of an international organization in rapid development, working with many exciting initiatives redefining the future of Circle K’s business. Furthermore, when they say that diversity and sustainability are on the agenda, they mean it, and they care—also about future generations. Circle K have several initiatives they would love to tell you more about when you meet.

Circle K’s four core values—One Team, Do The Right Thing, Take Ownership, Play To Win—reflect the culture you will become a part of. When joining the PMA team, you will learn that humor, professionalism and a willingness to take responsibility are significant parts of the company’s DNA. If you have the same DNA, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Do you have all the facts you need to make your next move? Then send us your CV and application via the link below. We process applications confidentially and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Gitte Hjortskov Larsen, Director of Executive Search & Recruitment at Basico, by phone at +45 2510 2217.

At Circle K, there is room for everyone, and they always work together as One Team! Circle K value diversity and different ways of thinking and working. Therefore, they encourage everyone to apply for the position—regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, ethnic background, etc. What matters most to Circle K is who you are as a person, and what you bring to the team. We therefore encourage you not to include a photo on your CV.

Actuarial Consultant

• Full-time

Job Description

Would you like to shape Denmark’s pension solutions of tomorrow? As our new Consultant, you’ll use your actuarial expertise to turn complex models and business logic into tangible solutions, creating value for clients and society. Join a major IT project and turn theory into practice.

Responsibilities

As a Consultant within the life and pensions industry, you will become part of a specialised team contributing to the development of a new, unified IT system for pension solutions in Denmark.

You will work at the intersection of deep expertise in actuarial mathematics and technical implementation in a dynamic, and ambitious environment. Your expertise will be at the heart of our work, and you will see your analyses, business insights, and models create direct value for our clients and their businesses. Your work will involve developing and implementing complex calculation models and ensuring that solutions meet both business and regulatory requirements.

In addition, you will gain broad insight into different companies within the pensions industry and develop expertise in delivering large-scale IT projects. You will work closely with actuaries and pension experts at our clients and contribute to building actuarial and pension-specific capabilities at Netcompany.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Developing and implementing calculation models for life and pension products.

• 
Quality assurance and testing of pension products, as well as bridging the gap between actuarial expertise and technical implementation.

• 
Ensuring that solutions comply with applicable legislation and standards.

• 
Communicating complex analyses and results to colleagues, developers, testers, and clients.

• 
Contributing to the design and customisation of insurance and pension products within our solutions.

About you

• 
You are a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant professional experience within actuarial mathematics.

• 
You hold a Master’s degree in actuarial science (cand.act.) or a similar relevant degree that has given you a strong academic foundation and a logical approach to handling large datasets and advanced models.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

We built Trustpilot to be that place.

On behalf of our client, Anticimex Innovation Center, Asgaard Recruitment is seeking a Senior Firmware Engineer to strengthen the firmware engineering team and contribute to the development, improvement, and industrialization of smart, connected products operating in demanding real-world environments.

Anticimex is a global leader in modern pest control and prevention. At Anticimex Innovation Center, ideas move from sketch to prototype to smart devices that transform pest control into a data-driven and more sustainable industry.

The role

As Senior Firmware Engineer, you will take a central role in developing and improving the firmware that brings connected devices to life, working closely with electronics, mechanics, and software/cloud teams to ensure that hardware and firmware perform reliably together.

The role combines hands-on firmware development with technical leadership. You will help set the professional standard for firmware design, support task coordination within the team, and contribute to stronger engineering practices across design reviews, release discipline, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation, and change management.

A key part of the role will be to help strengthen in-house firmware capabilities. Today, parts of the firmware development are handled by external partners, and Anticimex Innovation Center is now building stronger internal ownership of selected design, verification, and development activities.

You will work with embedded firmware for battery-powered IoT devices, low-power wireless connectivity, over-the-air updates, and production test support. The position is primarily based in Bagsværd. Some occasional travel to Helsinge expected to stay close to production, products, and technical problem-solving. Also, regular presence at the HQ of our strategic partner Sigma Connectivity in Lund, Sweden to be expected.

Your key responsibilities

You will:

• 
Develop and improve firmware for low-power, wireless IoT devices, from bring-up through production release

• 
Lead the structured transition of selected firmware development and verification activities from external partners to internal ownership, including tooling, documentation, and knowledge transfer

• 
Own firmware architecture in selected projects, including driver development, wireless connectivity stacks, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Contribute to verification and validation activities, including hardware/firmware bring-up, test planning, troubleshooting, certification readiness, and release processes

• 
Strengthen Stage-Gate execution, design review practices, documentation quality, engineering change processes, and controlled releases

• 
Collaborate closely with firmware architect, electronics, mechanics, software/cloud, production colleagues, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers

You will become a key technical voice in the firmware discipline, helping raise the engineering standard and ensuring that products are designed not only to work, but to work reliably at scale.

Who you are

You are an experienced firmware engineer with deep technical expertise and a strong interest in building connected products for the real world. You enjoy hands-on embedded development, structured problem-solving, and turning technical findings into robust, production-ready solutions.

You likely bring:

• 
7–10+ years of experience in embedded firmware development

• 
Strong experience with embedded C/C++ and real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare-metal development

• 
Experience with battery-powered IoT devices and low-power wireless connectivity (e.g. BLE, LoRaWAN, or cellular IoT)

• 
Experience with firmware architecture, driver development, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Experience with version control, automated testing, and CI/CD for embedded systems

• 
Experience working in structured product development models such as Stage-Gate

• 
Knowledge of security practices for connected devices (Ideally RED+CRA)

• 
Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you have experience with insourcing or transitioning development work from external partners, hardware bring-up and debugging (JTAG/SWD), cellular or LoRaWAN certification processes, PDM/PLM systems, ISO 9001, FMEA, or cloud/IoT platform integration.

Why Anticimex Innovation Center

Anticimex Innovation Center is at a pivotal moment. Moving from a fast-moving scale-up approach toward a more professional and scalable product-development organization, without losing agility.

Today, Anticimex has around 600,000 connected devices deployed globally, creating both strong proof of success and a need to further mature engineering practices, product robustness, and long-term ownership.

You will join an organization with strong ambitions, short decision paths, and real opportunities to influence how products are designed, improved, tested, documented, and industrialized. You will help raise the technical level of the firmware discipline and play an important part in building more scalable in-house development capabilities.

Is this you?

If you are motivated by embedded firmware development, low-power connected devices, technical problem-solving, and the opportunity to help shape the next generation of intelligent pest control solutions, we would like to hear from you.

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to join our Platform & Development department. You'll take ownership of frontend development across our SaaS products, working closely with developers, QA, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable software used by customers across the shipping industry.

Our stack centres on Next.js, React, Typescript and Vercel, backed by Azure and .NET Standard services, with Mapbox and tilesets powering our geospatial visualizations. We're an AI-fluent team — you'll be expected to use AI-assisted tools as part of how you work, not just be curious about them.

Qualifications

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications with React and Next.js.

• Build interactive maps and geospatial visualizations using Mapbox and tilesets.

• Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs, including .NET Standard services — with room to grow into full-stack work overtime.

• Contribute to modernizing our existing architecture, with an eye on maintainability, scalability, and security.

• Own features end-to-end: from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and monitoring (via tools like Monitive).

• Use GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code review, and CI/CD.

• Use AI-assisted development tools day-to-day to improve code quality, testing, and delivery speed.

• Share knowledge, raise technical risks early, and help shape how the team works.

What you bring

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and production software used by real customers.

• Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Solid grasp of frontend architecture: component design, state management, responsive UIs.

• Experience integrating frontend apps with REST APIs and backend services.

• Comfortable with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Genuinely AI-fluent: you already use AI coding tools and understand their limits, not just open to trying them.

• Clear communicator — able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (we'll teach the rest)

• Experience with Mapbox, tilesets, or geospatial data — no prior background required if you're keen to learn.

• Exposure to Vercel deployment workflows.

• Comfort working in Azure-based environments.

• .NET Standard experience, or interest in growing into full-stack work.

• Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools such as Monitive.

Additional Information

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site with hybrid flexibility

• Team: Platform & Development department

Why Coach Solutions

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability.

• Real influence: if you see the problem, you own it — and if you make the best argument, you win, regardless of title.

• An informal, social culture — monthly Friday bars, team events, summer and winter parties, family events, and more.

• A skilled mentor and an experienced, engineering-minded team eager to help you succeed.

• Room to grow — new responsibilities and career paths as the company scales.

Don't check every box?

That's okay — we'd still love to hear from you. If you have strong frontend experience, a passion for building great software, and the motivation to learn and grow, reach out. Let's build something meaningful together.

jobs.occupation: Launch your career as a Business Tech Consultant - join our Discovery Day!
jobs.description:
Are you a tech-minded graduate ready to make an impact within technology and transformation? Do you want to explore different career paths within consulting – and find the right match for you?

On 18-19 November 2026, we invite ambitious soon-to-be or recent Graduates to Deloitte’s Talent Discovery Days - your opportunity to get to know the different career paths and work with cases in Deloitte Technology & Transformation leading to a potential position in one of our offerings.

Technology & Transformation

In Deloitte Denmark, our Technology & Transformation teams work with the intersection of business and technology to help organizations navigate change and turn technology into practical, impactful solutions.

You will join a collaborative environment with ambitious colleagues, where learning, development, and teamwork are key – and where you get the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally.

What can you expect?

During the Talent Discovery Days, not two moments will be alike. You will collaborate with peers on case challenges, meet our consultants, and explore the different opportunities within Technology & Transformation. Among other things you will:

• Work on case exercises and tackle real-life client challenges with peers

• Meet our consultants and hear their career stories first-hand

• Explore our tech teams and discover where your skills and interests fit in

• Get the chance to move forward: based on the days, selected participants will be invited to individual interviews with the possibility of a job offer in the following period

Please note: Discovery Day takes place over two full days, and participants are expected to be able to attend both days. In addition, selected participants must be available for potential follow-up calls after both day 1 and day 2 as part of the assessment process.

Who are we looking for?

At Deloitte, we look for curiosity, drive, and passion for combining business and technology to create impact. A candidate who is:

A soon-to-be or recent graduate (up to 2 years of experience) within Computer Science, Engineering, IT or Business IT

• In possession of a valid Danish work and residence permit

• An interest in the balance and intersection between technology and business

• A problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges

• A passionate learner eager to grow your skills and career

• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments

• A candidate with a passion for collaborating with customers to solve their problems

Here you can read more about our offerings and what type of candidates they specifically are looking for:

AI & Data

In AI & Data, we help organizations solve their complex challenges by turning data into a strategic asset. This means you'll be hands-on with projects that span the entire data journey – from shaping AI strategy and building modern data platforms to developing and implementing agentic and generative AI, machine learning, analytics and automation solutions. You will collaborate with a team of advisors and deep-tech specialists to deliver tangible results for clients across all industries. We practice what we preach, applying AI-powered tools in our own work to enhance quality and accelerate delivery.

We are looking for curious and ambitious problem-solvers with a genuine interest in the connection between data, technology, and business. You don't need to be an expert yet, but an understanding of data engineering, data science, or AI concepts is essential, along with a strong desire to learn and grow.

ServiceNow

We combine consulting with hands-on implementation of ServiceNow solutions to help organizations streamline and future-proof their operations. Our work spans process automation, performance tracking, and digital workflow optimization across functions such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk and Compliance.

We are looking for curious and motivated candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You may lean more towards technical development or towards project and process work, but you should be interested in understanding how digital solutions support business outcomes.

You are not expected to have ServiceNow expertise before joining - competencies will be developed through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think abstractly and translate ideas into tangible solutions. For example, you should be able to interpret a written process description and visualize or structure it into a clear process flow.

Customer

At Deloitte Digital, we help organizations transform their front-office by designing and implementing CRM solutions across sales, marketing, and service. We are looking for talented colleagues who understand how technology supports customer-facing processes and are eager to work hands-on with CRM platforms.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of business and technology, can translate client requirements into practical solutions and is motivated to develop both functional expertise and technical skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

Finance Transformation

In Finance Transformation, we help organizations modernize and improve the entire CFO area, from invoicing and reporting to finance strategy and financial planning. By combining business insight, technology, data, and process excellence, we help finance functions become more efficient and better equipped to support strategic decision-making.

As a junior consultant, you will gain exposure to a variety of projects across the CFO agenda and work closely with both colleagues and clients. This gives you the opportunity to build a broad understanding of finance transformation before gradually developing deeper expertise within a specific area that matches your interests and strengths.

We are looking for curious and analytical candidates with an interest in the intersection of business, finance, and technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, and collaborating with stakeholders to create practical solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Supply Chain & Network Operations

In Supply Chain & Network Operations (SCNO), we help organizations transform how they plan, optimize, and execute their supply chains. You'll work hands-on configuring platforms like Kinaxis Maestro and SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), implementing decision intelligence solutions, and enabling resilient supply chains. You will collaborate with supply chain strategists, technical and industry experts to deliver transformational outcomes across complex, global supply networks.

You will translate supply chain requirements into technical solutions, work directly with client teams on implementation, and develop expertise in planning, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, and product lifecycle management. You'll gain exposure to digital thread designs connecting product design, manufacturing, and supply chain execution. You'll grow both technical skills in platform implementation and consulting skills in translating client challenges into designs.

We seek curious and ambitious candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You should be a collaborative team player who genuinely cares about client impact and learning from colleagues. You don't need platform expertise - competencies develop through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think systematically about interconnected processes, translate business requirements into technical specifications, and collaborate across teams.

Whats next?

Expected start: January 2027 & September 2027

Location: Deloitte, Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S

We only have a limited number of seats available, so do not hesitate to send your application before 8th November.

To apply, please upload your CV, you transcript of grades, and answer our three short questions. Please note that Talent Discovery Day is an invitation-only event. Once you have submitted your application and all required documents, we will review your profile.

You may attend the event only if you are selected and receive an official invitation email from Deloitte; submitting an application does not itself grant access to the event.

We will look at applications on an ongoing basis and you will receive answer no later than  11 November.

If you have any questions, please contact Sarah Manniche (Manager, People & Purpose).

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you experienced within information security, compliance and risk management? Do you enjoy turning requirements into practical processes and controls? Then you might be the person we’re looking for as our new Information Security & Compliance Manager.

Loyalty Key is a Nordic leader in the development and operation of digital loyalty solutions for the financial sector. We work with leading partners and clients to build secure, scalable loyalty platforms and services.

As our business and products continue to grow, information security and compliance are becoming increasingly important. We are therefore looking for someone who can take ownership of our security and compliance framework, help maintain our existing assurance setup and support us as we strengthen our compliance capabilities further.

You will work closely with management, IT and other teams across the organisation. The role will include coordinating audits, maintaining policies and controls, supporting risk assessments, following up on findings and helping ensure that security and compliance requirements are embedded in the way we work.

We are looking for someone who is structured, pragmatic and proactive. You should be comfortable working independently, but also enjoy collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You’ll be part of an ambitious team of 45 people, headquartered between Østerport and Nordhavn station. We work towards the same goal: staying ahead of customer needs and executing on them. We have an informal atmosphere, short decision-making paths and a culture where people are encouraged to take responsibility and make an impact.

It is a requirement that you have a residence and work permit in Denmark.

We are looking for someone with experience within information security, compliance, IT risk, audit or a related field.

You will work closely with our IT team, who are responsible for the technical implementation of security measures, while you will own and coordinate the governance, risk and compliance activities.

Your responsibilities will include

• 
Maintaining and developing our information security and compliance framework.

• 
Coordinating audits and maintaining relevant documentation and evidence.

• 
Supporting existing assurance requirements and future security and compliance certifications.

• 
Performing and following up on risk assessments and control activities.

• 
Maintaining security and compliance policies and procedures.

• 
Supporting supplier and third-party security assessments.

• 
Supporting customer security and compliance requests.

• 
Working closely with IT and other teams to ensure requirements are implemented in practice.

• 
Reporting relevant risks, findings and improvement initiatives to management.

Your qualifications

• 
Experience within information security, compliance, IT risk or audit.

• 
Experience working with security controls, audits or assurance frameworks.

• 
Good understanding of information security and technology.

• 
Strong organisational and documentation skills.

• 
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• 
A proactive and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• 
Experience from fintech, payments, SaaS, financial services or a similar environment is an advantage.

Experience with frameworks such as ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar is an advantage.

You do not necessarily need to be able to answer yes to all of the above to be considered for the position.

Why work at Loyalty Key

• 
An exciting role with a varied workday and a high degree of responsibility.

• 
A dynamic and inspiring workplace with dedicated colleagues.

• 
An informal and supportive work environment where your ideas and initiatives are valued.

• 
Opportunities for both professional and personal development.

• 
Salary according to qualifications, health insurance and attractive benefits.

• 
The opportunity to shape how we work with information security, risk and compliance as the company grows.

• 
Lots of social events, Friday bars and opportunities to celebrate our successes together.

Start date and location

Start date by agreement.

Address: Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Do you have any questions?

For further information, please contact Aaron Morley at aam@loyaltykey.com.

We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us a motivated application, your CV and any other relevant documents as soon as possible.

Are you motivated by the execution of large complex projects where you contribute throughout the entire project life cycle? Are you comfortable taking responsibility for planning your own work as well as coordinating the work of others that contribute to your part of the complete system? If so, then this job as Electrical Project Engineer may be the opportunity you have been looking for.

Join an international and multidisciplinary environment

In Aarhus, Denmark, you will be part of the Airport Electrical Project Engineering Team responsible for the electrical project engineering of highly automated baggage handling systems in some of the world's biggest airports. Here, you will be part of a larger team that takes the full responsibility for the mechatronic part of a complete system delivery.

As Electrical Project Engineer, you will have a versatile job in an international and multidisciplinary environment. As part of a project organization with responsibility for the electrical design, you will manage many stakeholders and ensure a lean process and high quality throughout the projects. In cooperation with the project-team you will identify the required work, plan your tasks, and coordinate your own work as well as the work of a small group that supports the electrical design.

You will be responsible for:

• Specifying, driving, and executing the electrical design of the complete system delivery.

• Smoothly incorporating changes into your design as they arise.

• Converting project solutions to standardised product solutions.

• Supporting the project during the on-site installation- and commissioning stages.

How to get the opportunity

You thrive in a position where you can work independently overseeing several tasks and responsibilities across ongoing projects contributing with your knowledge, structure, and the ability to find solutions supporting improvements and best practice. You thrive in an environment where your solutions are an integral part of a larger and complex solution.

You are an extrovert electrical engineer with excellent stakeholder management skills, and you understand how to ensure all team members and contributors are on track towards the delivery of a complete system solution. Furthermore you:

• Are an electrical engineer or similar with experience in hardware construction of electrical installations and control system design.

• Experience from a similar position driving project improvements with great success.

• Understand the Machinery Directive and international standards within electrical equipment.

• Are fluent in English in both verbal and written.

• Have solid project experience or experience working with improvements.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Team Manager, Electrical Project Engineering, Flemming Bruhn Jensen on +45 5373 6181 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

If you would like to play a committed part in our successful family business, you can apply online at beumergroup.com/career.

We look forward to meeting you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.
